lines.head: Leads could join hidden accounts
lines.sub: Conversion could match an account owned by another team.
lines.text: E4-6. A lead could be converted into a customer account that belonged to someone else's territory.
lines.say: E four six. A lead could be converted into a customer account that belonged to someone else's territory.

lines.head: Conversion is now blocked
lines.sub: A clear message explains who to ask for access.
lines.text: Now, if you don't have access to the matching account, conversion is blocked, with a clear message on who to ask.
lines.say: Now, if you don't have access to the matching account, conversion is blocked, with a clear message on who to ask.

lines.head: Owned by another salesperson
lines.sub: So this user can't add contacts or opportunities to it.
lines.text: Here, the Conscendo account is owned by another salesperson, so this user can't convert into it.

lines.head: Department carries over too
lines.sub: Once access is shared, conversion works as usual.
lines.text: Once the account is shared, conversion works as usual. And a lead's department now carries over to the contact.
